profile.description: Measured low-TTFA starting profile for one streaming request on an 8-core Intel AMX host.

hardware.notes: The host exposes 16 logical CPUs for 8 physical cores. This profile assumes SMT siblings are disabled and CPUs 0-7 remain online; verify that state before launch.

requirements.isa: AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, AMX tile, AMX INT8 and AMX BF16

precision.activations: fp32 at the API boundary; int8 packing is internal to matmat
precision.gemm_backend: AMX INT8 GEMM where the gate is met; shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI GEMM fallback; scalar/vector fallback otherwise

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: Matches the eight compute threads assigned to the single worker in this profile.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.revert: unset to let the engine size OpenBLAS per worker

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: Avoids idle OpenBLAS workers spinning against the engine pool.

QWEN_AMX_MIN_B.why: Allows AMX INT8 matmat from the first batched regime qualified by the engine.

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: Enables reuse of request-independent prefix work.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.why: Must remain absent so the shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI tile path is available when AMX is bypassed.
QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.revert: set QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE=1 only for a VNNI row-kernel control run

qualification.workload: One streaming request at client concurrency 1, with the same warmup and mixed-length text bank used for the single-stream thread sweep.
qualification.notes: This is a latency-first candidate, not a sustained-throughput recommendation. Requalify after the clean OSS VNNI tile path is included.
